title: Treasure pool and Fairness tidy-up
summary: The party screen is easier to scan: shorter tabs, a calmer treasure pool and a clear message before any loot is shared.
items: Players now find the party screen as "Party & inventory".
Party tabs no longer wrap, and the pool's count sits inside the Pool tab.
A treasure-pool item nobody has claimed shows "No claims yet" and how many can claim, instead of a list of "Not yet" rows.
Claim all as Pass marks Pass on every item you haven't marked yet; the Need, Greed and Pass buttons stay in place while claims update.
Fairness explains that no loot has been handed out yet instead of showing rows of 0 cp.
